Section: Authentication (in api_reference.pdf)
Path: API Reference > Authentication
---
Obtain an API token through the authentication endpoint using your client credentials. POST the client id and client secret to receive a bearer token.

Section: Rate Limiting (in api_reference.pdf)
Path: API Reference > Rate Limiting
---
The Team plan allows one thousand requests per minute. Exceeding the rate limit returns HTTP 429 with a retry-after header.

Section: Rollback (in deploy_procedure.pdf)
Path: Deploy Procedure > Rollback
---
If a deploy fails within thirty minutes, roll back immediately to the previous release and open a PagerDuty incident.

Section: Decision (in adr_007_vector_store.pdf)
Path: ADR 007 > Decision
---
We chose pgvector over Pinecone for on-premise data control and to avoid sending embeddings to an external managed service.

Section: Prerequisites (in deploy_procedure.pdf)
Path: Deploy Procedure > Prerequisites
---
Mandatory prerequisites before a deploy: passing tests, an approved code review, and a green continuous integration pipeline.

Section: SLA (in api_reference.pdf)
Path: API Reference > Service Level Agreement
---
The service level agreement guarantees a P99 latency under one second, even when a query is escalated to the cloud backend.

Section: Encryption (in security_overview.pdf)
Path: Security Overview > Encryption
---
All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and encrypted in transit over TLS 1.3 between every service.

Section: Schedule (in backup_policy.pdf)
Path: Backup Policy > Schedule
---
The backup schedule runs nightly incremental backups, retained for thirty days, with a weekly full snapshot.
